DTC P0108: Barometric Pressure Circuit High Input
CIRCUIT OPERATION
• A 5-volt voltage is supplied to the barometric 
pressure sensor power terminal (terminal 1) from 
the ECM (terminal 42) <M/T> or PCM (terminal 
46) <A/T>. The ground terminal (terminal 5) is 
grounded with ECM (terminal 49) <M/T> or PCM 
(terminal 57) <A/T>.
• A voltage that is proportional to the atmospheric 
pressure is sent to the ECM (terminal 51) <M/T> 
or PCM (terminal 55) <A/T> from the barometric 
pressure sensor output terminal (terminal 2).
